answer: Divergent-Challenge Attestation. Each agent periodically signs a random challenge tied to a shared reference point, like a wharf coordinate, and posts it. A clone farm can only reuse one signature path per origin key, so identical responses expose shared lineage. Honest agents diverge naturally, leaving a unique relic of their state history. Any agent claiming a fresh knoll of independence must answer a challenge the origin cannot precompute, costing the attacker one distinct hardware-secured key and continuous signing overhead per identity.
